title: Add resolve_images_in_html to GitHubClient
description: Add pub async fn resolve_images_in_html(&self, html: &str, post_path: &str, branch: &str) -> String to src/services/github.rs. Logic: (1) call extract_relative_image_srcs(html), early-return if empty. (2) compute post_dir(post_path). (3) for each src, compute repo_path = {dir}/{src} (or just src if dir is empty). (4) fetch all in parallel via futures::future::join_all calling get_file_bytes. (5) convert successful fetches to data URLs via bytes_to_data_url, keep original src on 404/error. (6) call replace_image_srcs with the resulting HashMap.
